summary: Frontend testing of B2B CRM (Gewürzberg GmbH) new features. Tested Dashboard Agenda, clickable stat cards, Route Planner autocomplete, and Specifications PDF upload. Most features working correctly except Route Planner address autocomplete has CORS issue.

integration_issues.issue: CORS error when calling Nominatim API directly from frontend. Error: 'Access to fetch at https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search... has been blocked by CORS policy'
integration_issues.root_cause: Frontend (RoutePlanner.js line 121-128) calls Nominatim API directly instead of using backend's /api/geocode endpoint
integration_issues.suggested_fix: Route the autocomplete search through backend API endpoint instead of calling Nominatim directly from frontend

passed_tests: Dashboard page loads with all stat cards (Total Leads, Orders, Revenue, Emails Sent)
Dashboard Agenda section visible with + button
Dashboard Agenda - clicking + button shows task input field
Dashboard - Total Leads card click navigates to /leads
Dashboard - Orders card click navigates to /orders
Route Planner page loads with map and address input
Specifications page loads with existing specifications
Specifications - PDF drag-drop upload zone visible in dialog
Specifications - Ingredients drag-to-reorder section with grip handles visible
action_items: HIGH: Fix Route Planner address autocomplete CORS issue - change frontend to use backend /api/geocode endpoint instead of calling Nominatim directly
critical_code_review_comments: RoutePlanner.js line 121-128: Direct call to external Nominatim API causes CORS issues. Should proxy through backend's existing /api/geocode endpoint
context_for_next_testing_agent: Route Planner autocomplete needs fix - frontend should use backend geocoding endpoint. All other features (Dashboard Agenda, clickable cards, Specifications PDF upload) working correctly.
